text:
2 Whether a position of trust or authority exists at the time of the offence is for the court to assess, and it is not
possible to provide a complete list of such situations. Examples may include relationships such as teacher and
student, employer and employee, or carer and dependant, including where this relationship is a familial one. It may
also include situations where there is no ongoing relationship or where the position of trust or authority is temporary,
such as childcare, or a taxi driver and a passenger.

3 All victims of this offence are considered vulnerable as a consequence of their age. Whether a victim has any
additional vulnerability at the time of the offence is for the court to assess, and it is not possible to provide a complete
list of such instances. It may include, for example, vulnerability of a continuing nature such as physical and mental
conditions or impairments, or of a temporary nature such as sleep or unconsciousness.
